issue.title: test_reflow_to_fit_ladder_picks_tier_by_width fails in isolation: width 20 stays full instead of compact
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/test_panel_tab_strip_compact.py::test_reflow_to_fit_ladder_picks_tier_by_width fails deterministically, including in isolation and on a tree with the sase-mv work stashed away.

Reproduction:
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_panel_tab_strip_compact.py::test_reflow_to_fit_ladder_picks_tier_by_width -p no:randomly -q --tb=short

Observed:
  After `await pilot.resize_terminal(20, 5)` the strip stays at `_tier == "full"`; the test expects `"compact"`. The same node also failed during an escalated `just check` full-suite run (32015 passed / 1 failed / 14 visual-env errors).

Not caused by the sase-mv config-cache work: `git stash` of that tree still fails the node.

Possible contributor: this workspace's Textual is 8.2.8, while the visual renderer pin is 8.0.1. Confirm whether resize_terminal at width 20 no longer drops the strip out of the full tier, or whether the ladder thresholds themselves drifted.

Scope: make the compact-tier rung of the reflow-to-fit ladder pass in isolation again. Do not treat this as a config-cache or ambient-reader flake.
